type: Original schematic reconstructions, not reproduced result figures

li2026shape.basis: Figure 1; method section; platform section. Auxiliary FAST supervision is training-only; EEF and joint streams are independent and executable.

li2026ctvam.basis: Figure 2 and Sections 4.1–4.2. Four independent attention streams, gated aggregation, rectified flow, flow-consistent inpainting.

li2026gpbound.basis: Figure 2 and robot experiments. GP learning, RWD and Lipschitz estimation, uncertainty bounds and constrained feedback control.

guo2026dgacmp.basis: Figure 2. Sphere tree/Laplacian deformation, two-stage strain approximation, Kelvin–Voigt force approximation, GP-prior trajectory optimization.

jiang2026stgp.basis: Figures 1–2. Point-cloud SDF estimation, spatial/temporal GPs and one-step Bayesian fusion.

ma2026dtcbf.basis: Method and quadrotor attitude simulation. Discrete dynamics, truncation order, relative degree, predictive safety horizon and generalized CBF constraints.

li2024humanswarm.basis: Figures 3, 9 and 12. Hierarchical Stackelberg–Nash game, integral RL, formation objectives and CBF safety control.

li2023uscbf.basis: Figure 1 and real-robot experiments. Separate environment and dynamics GPs, nominal/uncertainty barriers, learned compensation and QP control.
